items.heading: Saltah
details: Key ingredients: meat stew, fenugreek foam, rice, vegetables
Simmer a spiced meat and vegetable stew until tender.
Whip fenugreek with water until it forms a light, frothy foam.
Spoon the stew into a hot stone bowl over rice.
Top with the fenugreek foam just before serving, still sizzling.

items.heading: Mandi
details: Key ingredients: rice, lamb, smoke, saffron
Season lamb with a blend of warming spices.
Cook the lamb slowly in a pit or covered pot until very tender, capturing smoky flavor.
Cook rice with saffron and some of the lamb's cooking juices.
Serve the rice topped with the tender, smoky lamb.
